svg.title: Bias and variance shown as shot patterns on four targets
svg.desc: A two by two grid of targets. Columns are low and high variance, rows are low and high bias. Low bias low variance shows a tight cluster on the bullseye. Low bias high variance shows a wide scatter centred on the bullseye. High bias low variance shows a tight cluster away from the bullseye. High bias high variance shows a wide scatter away from the bullseye.
svg.text: Orange ring = true target · dots = models trained on different samples
